usage: No operator action needed: acceptance_basis_generate and the other topology steps now classify their own artifacts as lifecycle_artifact and pass the scope gate without manual scope_contract_acknowledge. When adding a new StoryStore top-level artifact, register its filename in LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES; lattice validate fails with a named divergence if you forget.

pitfalls: When adding a new StoryStore top-level artifact write, register the filename in LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES in the same commit or the lifecycle-registry consistency contract fails validate with a named divergence.
